hints.title: What matters?
hints.body: Only the number of each letter matters, not the order.

hints.title: Count the source
hints.body: Build a frequency table for the available letters.

hints.title: Consume the note
hints.body: Decrement a letter's count for every character in the note. A missing or zero count means failure.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
if len(note) > len(source): return false
counts = counts of source
for letter in note:
    if counts[letter] == 0: return false
    counts[letter] -= 1
return true
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
